title: Investigation into Handling and Communicating of Erratum in Recent GCE "A" Level Chemistry Examination Paper
what_it_is: Investigation into Handling and Communicating of Erratum in Recent GCE "A" Level Chemistry Examination Paper

sections.label: 2022 A Level Chemistry erratum
sections.summary: An erratum to an optional H2 Chemistry question was issued with the paper, and SEAB advised make-up time and marking consideration.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: In the 2022 GCE "A" Level H2 Chemistry paper 3, an erratum to one of the optional questions, affecting two sub-parts, worth one mark each, was issued together with the question paper to every student at the start of the examination.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: SEAB then issued the clarifications to the erratum and advised schools to give make-up time according to the duration of the announcement of the clarification.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Cambridge Assessment and SEAB will take this incident into consideration during marking and ensure that students are not disadvantaged.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: SEAB will also review the management of errata to avoid such incidents in future.

sections.label: Frequency of A Level errata
sections.summary: There were no errata in 2021 A Level papers and one typographical erratum in 2020, out of over 200 papers yearly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As to whether this is a common issue, I checked with my Ministry of Education (MOE) colleagues.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We had more than 200 "A" Level papers per year; no erratum in 2021 GCE "A" Level; and there was one erratum for one paper due to typographical error in 2020.

sections.label: Compensation for erratum clarification time
sections.summary: Time each examination centre takes to clarify the erratum is compensated so students have the same time to complete the paper.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The time taken by each examination centre to clarify on erratum will be compensated to the students, so that they still have the same amount of time that they need to complete the exam paper.
